<?php
class QuietEmptyArray {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): array { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return []; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "R;"; }
}
$reader = new QuietEmptyArray;
$selector = "empty";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietSharedPayload { public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; } }
class QuietSharedArray {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): array { global $reader, $items, $selector; echo "G;"; $saved = $items; $items = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "R;"; }
}
$items = [new QuietSharedPayload];
$held = $items;
$reader = new QuietSharedArray;
$selector = "shared";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_EMPTY;" : "ARRAY;";
echo $reader === null && $items === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($held);
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietStdPayload { public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }
class QuietStdObject {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): object { global $reader; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $saved = new stdClass; $saved->child = new QuietStdPayload; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "R;"; }
}
$reader = new QuietStdObject;
$selector = "object";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_EMPTY;" : "OBJECT;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_READER;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietLiteralPayload { public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; } }
class QuietLiteralObject {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader; echo "G;"; $reader = null; return new QuietLiteralPayload; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "R;"; }
}
function quietLiteralFallback() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return null; }
$reader = new QuietLiteralObject;
$answer = $reader->object ?? quietLiteralFallback();
echo $answer instanceof QuietLiteralPayload && $reader === null ? "OWNED;" : "BAD_RETURN;";
unset($answer);
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietCvCoalesce {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { echo "G;"; return new stdClass; }
}
$reader = new QuietCvCoalesce;
$selector = "object";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? null;
echo $answer instanceof stdClass ? "OBJECT;" : "BAD_OBJECT;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): array { global $reader; echo "G;"; $reader = null; return 7; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
};
$selector = "items";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? null; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getLine(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_READER;";
echo "DONE;";
